product.title: Cortech The Rock Insulated Food Tray - 2000
product.body_html:
The Cortech Rock Tray has a 10 year manufacturers warranty against breakage, cracking, or leakage. You can fit 132 trays in the Chuckwagon, 80 trays in the Chuckwagon Jr., and 156 trays in the Tray Master. The Rock Tray is ideal for use in all correctional facilities, prisons, and jails.

  • The radius corners and softly beveled bottom make it easier to eat from and easier to clean.
  • Made from an insulated material, THE ROCK has no internal insulation, which means it will not absorb water.
  • THE ROCK is manufactured with an FDA Approved Material and built to ISO Quality Standards.
  • THE ROCK carries a 10 Year Warranty Against Breakage, Cracking or Leaking.
  • Ideal for continuous, intensive use in extreme environments!
  • Available colors: 2000C Chocolate Brown, 2000DG Dark Grey, 2000TC Terra Cotta, and 2000O Orange.
  • Five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments, 2.25” deep.
  • Will stack with or without lids (sold separately).
  • Packed 10 per case, must buy in full cases. Price is per case.
The Rock one-piece seamless design insulated food tray, has been tested in correctional facilities with over 350 different menus. The 5 compartments have proven that they can handle any correctional meal, plus with the 2 additional condiment compartments, use of bulk condiment portions will yield a savings that can pay for the tray itself.


About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
